## How I tested it

<!-- Web/API: tsc green? Mobile: flutter analyze clean? What did you run or see? -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Matches the style of the surrounding code
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` (web/api) / `flutter analyze` (mobile) is clean
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or `.env` values committed
- [ ] Mirrored data files kept in sync (web `.ts` ⇄ mobile `.dart`), if applicable
- [ ] Qurʾānic text / transliteration / rules are accurate (source cited if in doubt)
